definitions.name: U2C.ISPRIME
definitions.note: TRUE when the positive integer has exactly two divisors (is prime).

definitions.name: U2C.FLAGS
definitions.note: Vector of readings -> numeric 0/1 Vector, 1 where the reading is NIL.

definitions.name: U2C.QTYREC
definitions.body: 'OS' BIND OS [ 'OA' BIND OA 'sku' GET ] MAP 'SK' BIND OS [ 'OB' BIND OB 'qty' GET ] MAP 'QT' BIND SK QT GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from sku to total qty, skus in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: U2C.CODES
definitions.body: 'CS' BIND [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ' ' ] [ 1 -1 2 -2 0 ] RECORD 'CR' BIND CR CS '            ' 2 COLLECT JOIN CHARS GET
definitions.note: Bracket String -> numeric codes ( 1, ) -1, [ 2, ] -2, with 12 trailing zero codes so the Vector is never empty.

definitions.name: U2C.PASS
definitions.body: 'PC' BIND PC -1 DROP 'PA' BIND PC 1 DROP 'PB' BIND PA PB ADD 'PS' BIND 0 PA LT PS 0 LT NOT PS 0 GT NOT AND AND 'PM' BIND PM [ FALSE ] CONCAT 'PL' BIND [ FALSE ] PM CONCAT 'PR' BIND 1 0 PL NOT PR NOT AND SELECT 'PK' BIND PC PK MUL 'PZ' BIND PZ 0 PC LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE PC LENGTH 1 PK SUB MUL ADD ORDER GET
definitions.note: One parallel pass over bracket codes: deletes every adjacent matched pair, compacts the rest to the front and zero-pads the tail.

definitions.name: U2C.REDUCE
definitions.note: Six U2C.PASS passes over bracket codes, which reach the fully reduced form (at most 12 characters, so 6 passes suffice).

definitions.name: U2C.UNMATCHED
definitions.body: U2C.CODES U2C.REDUCE [ 0 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: Bracket String -> count of characters left after repeatedly deleting adjacent matched pairs.
